name: auth-event-triage
title: Auth Event Triage
purpose: Correlate failed logins and subsequent success using event-time sliding windows, producing evidence for a SOC analyst.
limits: Normalized JSON input only. Source/user correlation is a heuristic; NAT, distributed attacks, MFA and identity aliases need analyst context. No live log collection.
next: Add password-spray correlation across users, JSONL streaming and labeled false-positive evaluation.

name: http-header-review
title: HTTP Header Review
purpose: Review captured HTTP response headers offline and explain actionable browser-hardening gaps.
limits: Heuristic policy review, not an XSS scanner or CSP parser conformance suite. Review application compatibility before adopting changes. No requests are sent.
next: Parse duplicate headers from HAR fixtures and add CSP nonce and report-only diagnostics.

name: file-integrity-ledger
title: File Integrity Ledger
purpose: Create bounded SHA-256 directory manifests and compare snapshots to identify additions, deletions and modifications.
limits: Manifest authenticity is not guaranteed; store trusted baselines separately. Read-only snapshot helper rejects symlinks, but is not hardened against concurrent hostile filesystem mutation.
next: Add signed manifests, metadata modes, platform-specific junction defenses and atomic snapshot strategies.

name: redacted-secret-audit
title: Redacted Secret Audit
purpose: Find likely credentials in supplied source text while returning only rule, line and irreversible fingerprints.
limits: Rule-based detection has false positives and misses unknown token formats. Fingerprints can reveal weak secrets by guessing; reports are still sensitive. No network verification or repository traversal.
next: Add directory scanning with explicit ignores, test corpus metrics and SARIF export with redaction regression tests.

name: iam-policy-lens
title: IAM Policy Lens
purpose: Review AWS-style identity policy JSON for broad allows and explain statement-level evidence.
limits: Static lint only. Does not compute effective permissions, service-specific resource semantics, SCPs, boundaries, trust relationships or condition satisfiability. Never changes cloud access.
next: Add service-aware resource requirements and condition analysis against documented fixtures.

name: firewall-path-explainer
title: Firewall Path Explainer
purpose: Simulate ordered first-match firewall rules for supplied packets and explain redundant or shadowed rules.
limits: A small source/protocol/destination-port model, not a device configuration parser. No destination IP, state, NAT, zones or routing. Default is deny. Does not touch real firewalls.
next: Add destination networks, IPv6 fixtures, rule hit statistics and vendor configuration adapters.

name: sbom-change-review
title: SBOM Change Review
purpose: Compare CycloneDX-style component inventories, detect ambiguous identities and explain version/license changes.
limits: No vulnerability database, license legal judgment, signature verification or dependency resolution. Stable bom-ref values are preferred; versioned purls can appear as removal/addition.
next: Normalize versioned package URLs, support dependency-edge changes and add schema validation.

name: certificate-expiry-board
title: Certificate Expiry Board
purpose: Prioritize exported certificate inventories by expiry and not-before dates using an explicit reproducible clock.
limits: Inventory review only; does not establish chain trust, hostname matches, revocation or live endpoint health. Does not contact hosts.
next: Import PEM certificates and add owner routing, inventory deduplication and renew-before windows.

name: backup-manifest-verify
title: Backup Manifest Verify
purpose: Verify a backup against trusted SHA-256 entries without restoring files, rejecting traversal and symlink paths.
limits: A matching digest does not prove a backup can restore an application. Baseline must be trusted. No extraction, writes or cloud access. Concurrent filesystem attacks and Windows junctions need additional defenses.
next: Add isolated restore drills, metadata verification and platform-specific safe-open handling.

name: dependency-runbook
title: Dependency Runbook
purpose: Compute deterministic recovery order and parallelizable stages for service dependencies, rejecting cycles and missing references.
limits: Planning only. Does not execute restarts or model readiness, resource contention and distributed consensus. Stages need human and service-specific health gates.
next: Add critical-path duration estimates and health-gated dry-run orchestration.

name: slo-budget-calculator
title: SLO Budget Calculator
purpose: Compute request-based error-budget consumption and burn rates for explicitly bounded observation windows.
limits: Request-based SLO only. Missing data is not healthy. Does not infer time-to-exhaustion or combine overlapping windows. Floating-point output is approximate.
next: Add multi-window burn alerts, explicit telemetry completeness and time-based SLO support.
publication: staged in auth-event-triage pending GitHub creation cooldown

name: incident-timeline-merge
title: Incident Timeline Merge
purpose: Normalize timestamped evidence into a UTC timeline, deduplicate stable IDs and detect contradictory records.
limits: Normalized JSON only. Timestamps do not prove causality; clocks may skew and evidence may be incomplete. Does not claim forensic chain of custody.
next: Add source clock uncertainty, immutable evidence digests and CSV import/export.
publication: staged in auth-event-triage pending GitHub creation cooldown

name: configuration-drift-map
title: Configuration Drift Map
purpose: Compare nested configuration snapshots using JSON Pointer paths with auditable exact-path ignores.
limits: Lists are compared as atomic values. Reports contain before/after values; redact credentials before supplying data. Ignores suppress entire subtrees at exact paths.
next: Add schema-aware secret masking, named baseline policies and list identity matching.
publication: staged in auth-event-triage pending GitHub creation cooldown

name: dns-zone-sanity
title: DNS Zone Sanity
purpose: Lint normalized DNS exports for CNAME collisions, malformed IP records and SPF policy mistakes without sending queries.
limits: Normalized export format only. SPF lookup count is a lower bound without recursive resolution. No DNS queries, DKIM validation, DNSSEC verification or full zone grammar.
next: Parse zone files, handle split TXT strings and add fixture-based SPF recursion with explicit query budgets.
publication: staged in auth-event-triage pending GitHub creation cooldown

name: ui-action-contracts
title: UI Action Contracts
purpose: Verify explicit UI contracts on disposable HTML with network blocked.
next: Add masked screenshots and checkbox fixtures.
